prompt:
Faithfully reconstruct ONE separate view of INEZ, the SAME adult woman in the attached original images. This is reconstruction, never character redesign. Original A (two portraits) has final authority for facial identity; original B (front/rear body and face) has final authority for body/costume. Any attached approved generated views are supplemental consistency guides; originals override them. Never use generated guides as sole identity evidence. Preserve original facial proportions: elongated slightly hooded green-hazel eyes, natural original eye size and spacing, substantial softly rounded nose tip/alar width, full but natural lips with fuller lower lip and slightly irregular Cupid's bow, soft cheek volumes and rounded substantial chin/lower face. No narrow nose, pointed chin, larger eyes, glamour retouch or makeup. Preserve the uneven source freckles (restrained forehead density), pores, warm-neutral real skin and subtle red/brown variation. Medium-brown untidy wavy/curly hair in loose high ponytail, lifted crown and asymmetric forehead/temple curls to jaw/neck. No sleek hair, bun, braid or alternative hairstyle. Keep body silhouette moderate and original, no slimming or exaggerated anatomy. Costume remains roomy cropped charcoal-gray coarse knit crew-neck sweater with THREE broad very dark navy/charcoal torso stripes and wider gray intervals, gray ribbed collar/cuffs/hem and roomy long sleeves; loose high-waist washed nearly black jeans, no belt; black tall lace-up rounded-toe thick-platform combat boots with subdued black hardware/seams and continuous black soles, absolutely NO yellow/tan welt stitching, branding or buckles; very fine silver necklace with original tiny irregular pointed pendant, no enlarged or newly symbolic charm. Exact hidden profile geometry and tiny pendant motif are not known from originals; make conservative internally consistent proposals, not decorative invented detail. All views: consistent soft neutral studio lighting, uniform light-gray seamless background, photoreal physically plausible anatomy/materials, orthographic or 100mm long-lens perspective, sharp clear surfaces without strong depth-of-field, no dramatic acting or poses, no beauty filters, stylization, inset, labels, collage, sheet or watermark. ONE view only.

REQUESTED VIEW: One complete head-to-toe TRUE anatomical LEFT SIDE (90 degrees), nose points IMAGE LEFT, minimal orthographic distortion. Same original proportions, neutral shallow A-pose, outfit, stance, arm/leg lengths and scale as accepted front body. Use the SAME portrait canvas/body scale with about 2-3% top margin and 4-5% bottom margin; full crown, ponytail, all naturally visible fingers and complete boot soles in frame. Hidden far limbs may be naturally occluded, never missing/truncated. Relaxed level head and forward gaze, no contrapposto or fashion pose. Side silhouette must show coherent forehead/nose/lips/chin, natural chest/abdomen/back and jean volume without an invented exaggerated bust or narrowed waist. Accurate ponytail projection from high rear attachment with dense irregular curls ending on upper/mid-back, no bun. Maintain cropped hem/small midriff, ribbed cuffs, stripe continuity around sleeve/torso, roomy jeans gathered at boot tops, and thick flat black platform combat boot profile. Side body depth is a conservative reconstruction, not directly measured original geometry.

SUPPLEMENTARY GUIDE SCOPE: Any attached 05_body_front is approved ONLY for whole-body geometry, neutral A-pose and silhouette. Its warm boot stitching and denim wash/microtexture are rejected and MUST NOT propagate. Original B governs denim and costume; attached approved boots guide (if present) supports neutral black seams only.

PROFILE GUIDE SCOPE: Attached approved left profile supports coherent conservative face silhouette only. Its ponytail appears too long; DO NOT copy its tail length. Original B rear ponytail reaches the upper-back stripe region and remains the final hair-length/volume authority. For true right/side views, far eye/far lashes must naturally occlude at 90 degrees.
